patient.primary_care_physician: Dr. Angela Martinez, MD (Heart Failure Specialist)

discharge_profile.primary_diagnosis: Acute on Chronic Systolic Heart Failure Exacerbation (HFrEF, EF 30%)
procedures: Inpatient IV Diuresis and Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT) optimization
discharge_profile.dietary_instructions: Strict low sodium (<2,000 mg daily). Strict fluid restriction of 1.5 Liters (48 oz) per day.
discharge_profile.activity_restrictions: Pace daily activities. Rest when fatigued. No vigorous exertion.
discharge_profile.wound_care_instructions: No surgical wounds. Inspect lower legs and ankles daily for pitting edema.

medications.frequency: Twice daily (Morning and 2 PM to avoid nighttime urination)
medications.indication: Loop diuretic for fluid control and edema prevention
medications.warning: Do not skip. Weigh self daily.

medications.indication: ARNI for heart failure neurohormonal blockade
Electrolyte repletion due to diuretic loss

red_flag_warnings: Weight gain of 3 lbs or more in a single day, or 5 lbs in one week
Shortness of breath when lying flat requiring extra pillows (orthopnea)
Waking up suddenly at night gasping for air (paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea)
New or worsening swelling in ankles, legs, or abdomen
Dizziness, lightheadedness, or feeling faint when standing up
Resting heart rate consistently above 110 or below 50 bpm

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Morning Dry Weight & Blood Pressure Log
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Weigh yourself first thing after urination, before breakfast. Record weight accurately.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Morning Diuretic & Heart Failure Meds
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Take Furosemide 40mg, Entresto, Carvedilol, and Potassium Chloride with breakfast.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Fluid Intake Checkpoint (Limit 1.5L / 48 oz)
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Log total fluid consumed so far today. Remember soup and ice count toward your limit.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Afternoon Diuretic Dose (Furosemide 40mg)
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Take second dose of Lasix. Taking before 2 PM prevents disrupted sleep.
